title: 25万亿六网建设：年内落地多少，能否对冲地产与制造双重压力？
speaker: Helen Chao

segments.en: So 25 trillion Renminbi of investment. Is this really going to be enough to offset sort of the turn that we're at the downturn that we're seeing investment in the economy?
segments.zh: 25万亿元的配置规模，真的足以对冲当前经济中配置动能的下行变化吗？

segments.en: Well, at the moment, I think it's hard to tell mainly because we don't know how much of that would be allocated in this year versus the rest of four years, the rest of five years.
segments.zh: 目前很难判断，主要是因为不知道今年会落地多少，其余部分要分摊到未来四到五年。

segments.en: But we would say that it could potentially help at a time when overall success at the investment has been decelerating quite significantly. In fact, it's starting from second half 2025.
segments.zh: 但它可能带来帮助，因为整体配置动能已明显放缓，实际上从2025年下半年就开始了。

segments.en: We already saw that FAI growth were coming down pretty sharply as the result of a combination of three things happening. Local governments running out of money, so infrastructure, investment, or a week, and property, investment, or we're still in terrible shape.
segments.zh: 我们已经看到固定资本形成增速明显回落，这是三重因素叠加的结果：地方政府资金紧张，基建动能偏弱，地产相关配置仍处于调整之中。

segments.en: And at the same time, because of anti-immolution and over-capacity, the manufacturing-related investment, or bear a week.
segments.zh: 同时，由于反内卷和产能过剩，制造业相关配置也相对偏弱。

segments.en: So on the back of that, we think that the Chinese government is rolling out this six networks investment as the future for infrastructure investment.
segments.zh: 在此背景下，我们认为中国政府正推出六网建设，作为未来基建配置的方向。

segments.en: And that, I think, is very helpful at the moment, because at a time when private parties are relatively lack of confidence to invest,
segments.zh: 我认为这在当前非常有帮助，因为民营部门信心相对不足、扩张意愿偏弱。

segments.en: the only hope we can place on is for public sector to borrow, and especially central government, or central government-owned SOEs to borrow more. So that's kind of how it differentiates from the past.
segments.zh: 唯一可寄望的是公共部门加杠杆，尤其是中央政府和央企国企增加融资，这也是与过去不同的地方。
